mentions.name: Super Giving
mentions.description: A Germany-specific charity donation platform for centrally managing donations. Users choose charities from a curated list (DZI-listed organizations plus Wikimedia Deutschland), set up a recurring donation to a central bank account, and the service redistributes the money according to the user's chosen split. It sends no email or postal marketing spam and provides a single year-end PDF for tax returns. The project takes no cut of donations, will be self-funded at first, and its source code will be released as open source.
mentions.problem: Donating to multiple charities separately brings marketing spam in email and snail mail, and scattered records for tax returns.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a charity + website (not live yet) that allows you to centrally manage your charity donations.
